implementation_note: NOT a published FBP method -- frozen foundation features + MLP head

setup.deviation_from_paper: DINOv3 would be the stronger choice but its weights are gated behind a licence requiring personal details, so the ungated Apache-2.0 DINOv2 ships instead. Early stopping on the validation split (patience 5) replaces the paper's fixed schedule: benchmark-v1 is a single fixed split, so a fixed epoch count would report whatever the last epoch produced rather than the method's best honest result.
setup.notes: Not a published FBP method. Frozen DINOv2 ViT-B/14 features (CLS + mean-pooled patches) with a small MLP head, plus horizontal-flip test-time augmentation. Included because the 2025-2026 results suggest the binding constraint at 1,399 training images is the representation, not the head: MD-Net's ablation loses more from removing its pretrained prior (0.021 PC) than from replacing its fusion (0.011). Learning rate is 1e-3 rather than 1e-4 because only the head trains.
